name: DeepRoot
description: The visual and written language of deeproot.ai and its DataLLM product. Warm neutrals on paper, a copper hexagon for every object, achromatic graphite for every commit action.

derivedFrom.note: Not generated from parameters — extracted from a shipped product redesign. Every value traces to one of these artefacts.
artefacts: deeproot-theme.css — the canonical 688-line token + component layer
deeproot-ui-redesign.html — a clickable 10-screen prototype (component inventory + copy)
INTEGRATION.md — colour measurement, the CVD problem, two shipped bug fixes
scheme-a-deuteranopia-check.png — the simulation justifying graphite actions

principle.statement: Copper is identity and selection. Graphite is every commit action.
principle.reasoning: Copper sits at hue 15deg, between amber and red. As a button fill it placed commit in the same hue band as alarm — measured 39 apart under deuteranopia, below the 40 confusion threshold.
principle.statusEncoding: Warn and risk are separated by luminance, not hue. Worst-case pair separation is 53, up from 29.

action.role: every committing action; achromatic by design

accent.role: identity and selection only — never a button fill

shell.role: the nav rail; dark in BOTH light and dark themes

type.mono: JetBrains Mono — identifiers, shortcuts, rule expressions
type.floor: 11.5px on screen; 24px in slides and print
type.tabularFigures: .dr-num, mandatory in any column of numbers
type.substitutionFlagged: No font binaries were supplied. Loaded from Google Fonts; self-host for enterprise.

shape.shadows: three, warm-tinted rgba(24,16,16,…) — never neutral black

signature: The hexagon. The logo mark is a hexagon, so every object — source, agent, profile, workflow stage — wears one instead of a rounded square.

icons.rule: never hand-roll a path, never substitute an emoji

integration.required: .dr, .dr *, .dr *::before, .dr *::after { box-sizing: border-box } — the theme does not set it
integration.scope: class="dr" on an ancestor; the whole component layer is scoped to it

knownGaps: all figures in kits and specimens are illustrative
